newsitem.title: CHINA: Jan-July tax income of China's Guangdong up.
newsitem.headline: Jan-July tax income of China's Guangdong up.

text.p: China's booming southern province of Guangdong collected 16.26 billion yuan ($1.96 billion) in taxes in the first seven months of 1996, up 15 percent from the same 1995 period, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
The figure accounted for 60 percent of the province's tax target for the whole year, the agency said.
Revenue from individual income tax was 1.5 billion yuan in the period, a rise of more than 30 percent from the year-ago period, it said.
